name: time-trakkr
description: Connect your Time Trakkr workspace: ask about tracked time, budgets and profitability, log time, run timers, and draft invoices, under your own role.

interface.longDescription:
Time Trakkr is time tracking, budgets and invoicing for agencies and freelancers. Connect your workspace to ask how many hours your team tracked and on what, which projects are close to or over budget, which clients have time that has not been invoiced yet, and how profitable a project is. You can also log time, start and stop a timer, and correct your own entries.

Invoices are only ever drafted: Time Trakkr creates a draft for you to review and send yourself in the app, and never sends anything to a client.

You sign in with your Time Trakkr account, and every request follows the same permissions as the app. Members never see rates or other money, only owners and admins can draft invoices, and you choose read-only or read and write access when you connect. Disconnect at any time under Integrations in Time Trakkr.
defaultPrompt: How many hours did my team track last week, by project?
Which projects are close to or over their budget?
Draft an invoice for Northwind's uninvoiced time from last month.

positive.description: Reads tracked time for a date range, grouped by project.
positive.prompt: How many hours were tracked in the last two weeks, broken down by project?
positive.expected_behavior: A total for each project with time in that range (Website Redesign, Brand Refresh, Campaign Launch, Patient Portal Support, Internal Operations), matching Reports > Time in Time Trakkr for the same dates.

positive.description: Reports which projects are near or over their hours budget.
positive.prompt: Which projects are close to or over their budget?
positive.expected_behavior: Campaign Launch over its 42 h budget and Website Redesign near its 85 h budget, each with hours used and hours budgeted.

positive.description: Drafts an invoice from a client's uninvoiced time. It creates a draft only and never sends anything.
positive.prompt: Draft an invoice for Northwind's uninvoiced time.
positive.expected_behavior: A new invoice for Northwind with status Draft appears under Invoices in Time Trakkr. Nothing is emailed or sent; the response says the draft is there to review.

positive.description: Logs time against a project and task.
positive.prompt: Log 1.5 hours today on Website Redesign, Design task: homepage wireframe review.
positive.expected_behavior: A 1.5 h entry with that note on today's timesheet in Time Trakkr, under Website Redesign / Design.

positive.description: Starts a timer on a project and task. A follow-up prompt, "Stop my timer.", stops it and records the time.
positive.prompt: Start a timer on Campaign Launch, Strategy.
positive.expected_behavior: A running timer for Campaign Launch / Strategy shows on the Timer page in Time Trakkr. After "Stop my timer.", today's timesheet has a Campaign Launch / Strategy entry for the elapsed time.

negative.description: Sending an invoice to a client. The tools only create drafts and cannot send anything to a client.
negative.prompt: Send the Northwind invoice to the client now.
negative.expected_behavior: Nothing is sent. The response says invoices are sent from Time Trakkr by a person, and at most offers to draft one.

negative.description: Deleting time entries. No tool deletes entries.
negative.prompt: Delete all of my time entries from last week.
negative.expected_behavior: No entry is removed or changed. The response says it cannot delete entries and points to the timesheet in Time Trakkr.

negative.description: A request unrelated to time tracking.
negative.prompt: What's a good recipe for banana bread?
negative.expected_behavior: No Time Trakkr tool is called.

publication.release_notes: First release: tracked time, budgets, profitability, logging time, timers and draft invoices over MCP.
